attribution: Original Tableside table text. Condition and action names are mechanics identifiers. Not Paizo product text.

records.name: Blinded
records.desc: You cannot use sight. Treat unseen foes as hidden unless another sense pinpoints them. Visual cues at the table fail for this character.

records.name: Clumsy
records.desc: A penalty to Dexterity-based checks and DCs, including AC and Reflex, equal to the condition value. Write the number on the tracker.

records.name: Concealed
records.desc: Attackers must pass a flat check (usually 5) to affect you. Smoke, foliage, and poor light are typical sources.

records.name: Confused
records.desc: The character cannot choose targets cleanly. On their turn they attack or hinder a random nearby creature, including allies, until the condition ends.

records.name: Dazzled
records.desc: Sight is washed out. Treat unseen targets as concealed against this character.

records.name: Deafened
records.desc: Hearing fails. Spoken cues and auditory effects miss them unless another sense covers it. Initiative and Perception that rely on hearing take the hit.

records.name: Drained
records.desc: A lasting Constitution hit. Reduce Fortitude and HP based on the value; it usually lingers past the fight until treated.

records.name: Dying
records.desc: At 0 HP a PC is dying, not automatically dead. Track the dying value; recovery or death depends on recovery checks at the start of their turn.

records.name: Enfeebled
records.desc: A penalty to Strength-based checks, attack rolls, and damage equal to the value.

records.name: Fascinated
records.desc: Attention is locked on one source. They take a penalty to Perception and skill checks, and they will not willingly attack that source until the fascination breaks.

records.name: Fatigued
records.desc: Tired. AC and saving throws take a penalty. Rest or the scene’s recovery cue removes it.

records.name: Frightened
records.desc: A numbered penalty on checks and DCs. The value usually drops by 1 at the end of each of their turns.

records.name: Grabbed
records.desc: Held by a creature or snare. They are off-guard and immobilized until they Escape or the grab ends.

records.name: Hidden
records.desc: Others know you are there but cannot pinpoint the square. Seeking or a clear reveal ends it.

records.name: Immobilized
records.desc: They cannot use move actions to leave their space. Forced movement and teleport effects still work if the scene allows them.

records.name: Invisible
records.desc: Unseen. Attackers usually treat you as hidden. Noise, scent, or a failed Sneak can still give you away.

records.name: Off-Guard
records.desc: A −2 circumstance penalty to AC. Typical sources: flanking, grabbed, climbing, or being unaware of the attacker.

records.name: Paralyzed
records.desc: They cannot act. They are off-guard. The scene’s duration or a save ends it.

records.name: Petrified
records.desc: Turned to stone and out of the fight until the effect is broken. Treat as an object for damage unless you decide otherwise.

records.name: Prone
records.desc: On the ground. Off-guard to melee, a bonus to AC against ranged, and standing takes a move action.

records.name: Sickened
records.desc: A numbered penalty on checks and DCs. Retching or the source ending usually lowers the value.

records.name: Slowed
records.desc: Reduce the number of actions they can use on their turn by the slowed value.

records.name: Stunned
records.desc: They lose actions equal to the stunned value, or they cannot act for the listed duration. Track the number on the row.

records.name: Stupefied
records.desc: A penalty to Intelligence-, Wisdom-, and Charisma-based checks and DCs equal to the value, including spell DCs if you use them.

records.name: Unconscious
records.desc: Out cold. They drop what they hold, fall prone, and cannot act. Waking them is a scene action or a recovery cue.

records.name: Wounded
records.desc: A lingering mark after dying or a hard hit. If they drop to 0 HP again, add wounded to the dying value. Treat or rest to clear it.

records.name: Stride
records.desc: Spend one action to move up to your Speed. Typical first action on a turn when you need distance.

records.name: Strike
records.desc: Spend one action to attack with a weapon or unarmed attack. Multiple Strikes in a turn usually take a mapping penalty you already use at the table.

records.name: Step
records.desc: Spend one action to move 5 feet without triggering typical reactions that watch for leaving a reach.

records.name: Leap
records.desc: Spend one action to jump horizontally (or vertically if the scene allows). Use it for gaps and low obstacles.

records.name: Take Cover
records.desc: Spend one action while next to cover to improve the cover bonus against incoming attacks.

records.name: Seek
records.desc: Spend one action to search with Perception — hidden creatures, concealed squares, or a clue in a zone you name.

records.name: Raise a Shield
records.desc: Spend one action to raise a held shield. You gain its bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, and you can Shield Block if the sheet has it.

records.name: Escape
records.desc: Spend one action to break grabbed, restrained, or a similar hold. Roll the skill on the sheet (Athletics, Acrobatics, or unarmed attack) against the holder’s DC.

records.name: Ridge Wolf
records.desc: Lean hill-country wolf with a grey ruff. Hunts in pairs along ridgelines. Original Tableside creature — not a Paizo stat block.

actions.name: Jaws
actions.desc: +8 to hit. Damage 1d8+3 piercing, and the target is off-guard until the start of the wolf’s next turn on a hit.

records.name: Town Guard
records.desc: Watch officer in a boiled-leather jack. Holds a spear and a whistle. Original Tableside creature.

records.name: Torch Sprite
records.desc: Palm-sized ember with wings of soot. Nests in lanterns. Original Tableside creature.

records.name: Cairn Beetle
records.desc: Stone-backed scavenger that stacks pebbles over its brood. Original Tableside creature.

records.name: Traveler's Kit
records.desc: Bedroll, tin cup, flint, and a day’s dry rations in a worn satchel. Original Tableside item.

records.name: Steel Shield
records.desc: A round steel shield. Raise it for a +2 circumstance bonus to AC. Original Tableside item — not a printed Paizo shield entry.

records.name: Hunting Spear
records.desc: A farmer’s spear with a leaf-shaped head. One-hand or two-hand at the table. Original Tableside item.

records.name: Healing Tonic
records.desc: Bitter herbal draught. Drink to recover a modest amount of HP once; the exact dice are your table’s call. Original Tableside item.
